Klein 0.1.0a2 is an alpha bugfix release focused on batch SQL correctness.
Users running joins on nullable keys should upgrade from 0.1.0a1.

## Highlights

- **Batch SQL:** Equality joins return all matching rows when input blocks
  contain nullable keys or infer different numeric types. This also corrects
  downstream aggregates that previously received incomplete join results.
  ([#100](https://github.com/yuchen-ecnu/klein/pull/100))
- **SQL catalog:** `DROP TABLE` works with SQLGlot 30.23 as well as earlier
  supported versions. ([#100](https://github.com/yuchen-ecnu/klein/pull/100))

## SQL

### Fixes

- Fix missing matches in batch equality joins when NULL placement changes a
  block's key representation. NULL keys do not match each other; outer joins
  retain the unmatched rows. Composite keys, duplicate matches, and integer
  keys above `2**53` retain their expected semantics.
  ([#100](https://github.com/yuchen-ecnu/klein/pull/100))
- Preserve the original join-key columns from both input tables so qualified
  projections and subsequent joins can reference either side.
  ([#100](https://github.com/yuchen-ecnu/klein/pull/100))
- Preserve schemas for empty inputs and empty intermediate results. Chained
  `USING` joins now keep the coalesced unqualified key while qualified columns
  retain their original values, including in `RIGHT` and `FULL` joins.
  ([#100](https://github.com/yuchen-ecnu/klein/pull/100))
- Accept SQLGlot's updated `DROP TABLE` representation. Unsupported statements
  targeting multiple tables are rejected before any catalog entry is removed.
  ([#100](https://github.com/yuchen-ecnu/klein/pull/100))

Regression coverage includes comparisons with SQLite for nullable and composite
keys, outer joins, multi-table joins with aggregation and Top-N, and CTEs with
`UNION ALL`.

## Upgrade

```bash
python -m pip install --upgrade "ray-klein==0.1.0a2"
```

Python **3.10–3.12** and `ray[data]>=2.56.1,<2.57` remain supported. No SQL API
or configuration migration is required for these fixes. Rerun affected batch
queries to regenerate results produced by 0.1.0a1. Install the same Klein
version on the driver and all Ray workers before submitting new jobs.

## Known issues

The streaming replay-buffer recovery issue identified during alpha testing
remains open. Set `pipeline.replay-buffer.enabled=false` to use full checkpoint
recovery when evaluating fault recovery. This release does not change replay
behavior. See the [upgrade guide](https://yuchen-ecnu.github.io/klein/latest/upgrading.html)
for stateful jobs; alpha releases do not promise checkpoint compatibility.

**Full changelog:** [v0.1.0a1...v0.1.0a2](https://github.com/yuchen-ecnu/klein/compare/v0.1.0a1...v0.1.0a2)
